faq.headline: Event Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your event site.

items.question: Can I sell tickets directly?
items.answer: A website can link to your existing ticket provider. Built-in ticket sales are not promised here.

items.question: Can I change the schedule?
items.answer: Yes. Edit the event page when a session or time changes.

items.question: Can guests ask accessibility questions?
items.answer: Add clear access details and a contact path so your team can answer specific questions.

items.question: What information should an event page include?
items.answer: Include the date, schedule, speakers, venue, directions, accessibility details, and an organiser contact so guests can plan their visit.

items.question: Can I link guests to registration or tickets?
items.answer: Yes. You can direct guests to an existing ticket provider. Ticket inventory, payment, and registration management are handled by that provider.

items.question: Can I publish schedule changes after the page is live?
items.answer: Yes. Update the event page when sessions, speakers, or timings change, and make important changes easy for attendees to find.
